verdict.rationale: The marketing site says ObsessionDB lets you "compute your bill before you talk to us" and compare it one-to-one with your current managed ClickHouse spend, which implies a self-serve cost calculator. The free developer tier's limits (up to 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, no credit card) are also documented. However, the pack shows no actual unit prices, billing dimensions or paid-tier rates, and the cost audit offer is a sales-assisted engagement rather than self-serve estimation. missing for 10: published per-unit pricing (compute, storage, egress), documented billing dimensions for paid tiers, evidence of the calculator's inputs and outputs, independent confirmation that estimates match real bills
